skill.summary: Help install, configure, run, troubleshoot, and extend MolecularAI REINVENT4 for generative molecular design. Use when the user mentions REINVENT4 or Reinven...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the REINVENT4 support skill for generative molecular design workflows.
- Provides guidance on installation, backend selection, configuration editing, running, troubleshooting, and extending REINVENT4.
- Emphasizes using and verifying with a local REINVENT4 checkout and upstream reference files.
- Covers environment setup, TOML config usage, plugin integration, notebook conversion, and test execution.
- Includes specific advice and warnings for different platforms and dependency scenarios.
